findings.description: The bucket has no ACL defined and is explicitly noted as public, with no server-side encryption configuration, exposing the sensitive customer-master.xlsx object stored within it to unauthorized access and unencrypted storage.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, meaning data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in unencrypted public bucket
findings.description: A sensitive customer master spreadsheet is uploaded to aws_s3_bucket.data, which is publicly accessible and unencrypted, directly exposing confidential customer data to unauthorized parties.
The financials bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving potentially sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
The operations bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
The data_science bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest despite having logging and versioning enabled.
